content.text:
The hypothesis says it extends "the only positive prior result (submission 4)" with less noise. That corresponds to claim 2, which describes the first attempt as the only encouraging result. It also matches claim 10, which suggests longer smoothing of flow-rate ratios. The expression smooths over 6 months. Claim 8 concerns a stock-versus-flow spread and is not the same as this one. Claim 6 concerns regime gating, which this expression does not use.

Claim 3 gives the stats of the positive result, but the hypothesis doesn't test them directly.

The hypothesis builds on the positive prior result (claim 2) and applies the "longer smoothing" next step (claim 10).

{"uses_claim": true, "claim_ids": [2, 10]}
